candidate_workaround: Emit one skill name per output record with a real newline separator and assert the twenty-record count before initialization.
failure_signature: The first skill-name enumeration emitted one literal backslash-n record, so the twenty-skill guard stopped before initialization.
recurrence_guard: Use a line-emitting separator such as chr(10), then assert exactly twenty skill names before any write.
rollback: Give the failed enumeration zero credit and create no partial skills until the exact count is attributable.
scope_boundary: Same-owner phase-local skill initialization only; no global installation, subagent, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Bounded skill-name enumeration before initialization
trigger_preconditions: A shell wrapper consumes Python-emitted skill names as separate records.
